key_insight: Encoding the ICD-10-CM hierarchy explicitly helps EHR foundation models learn better disease representations than treating diagnosis codes as flat tokens.
clinical_relevance: Hierarchy-aware coding may improve clinical prediction and cross-dataset transfer by preserving medically meaningful relationships between related diagnoses.
method: Augmented a BERT-style transformer with ICD hierarchy level tokens.
Built graph-based code representations using hierarchy-aware edges plus diagnosis co-occurrence links.
Compared flat vs hierarchy-aware models across multiple hierarchy levels and tasks.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on MIMIC-IV for pretraining/in-domain testing and eICU for frozen-encoder cross-dataset transfer, showing hierarchy-aware models outperform flat code representations.
watch_item: The most useful hierarchy level depends on the task and model, so implementation choices may need tuning rather than using a single universal coding depth.
paper_title: Hierarchical Modeling of ICD Codes in EHR Foundation Models
